asserts.source:
local EMPTY=-197121
local seen,nonempty,colors=0,0,{}
for i=1,200 do
  local c=query.control('cell'..i)
  if c then
    seen=seen+1
    if c.imageColor==nil then error('cell'..i..' 读不到 imageColor —— 断言层缺字段，本用例会恒真，先修工具') end
    if c.imageColor~=EMPTY then nonempty=nonempty+1 colors[#colors+1]=i..'='..tostring(c.imageColor) end
  end
end
assert(seen==200,'棋盘格只找到 '..seen..' 个（应为 200）')
assert(nonempty>0,'开覆盖屏回来后棋盘是空的：nonempty=0 说明要么没落块、要么被重置')
return 'nonempty='..nonempty..' cells='..table.concat(colors,',',1,math.min(4,#colors))
